institutions.name: City Council
knownBiases: Approves visible projects (ribbon-cuttings) faster than invisible maintenance (load-bearing repairs).
Prefers a formal ordinance over admitting a structure was never properly permitted.
institutions.notes: Issues final authorization for changes and grants permits of record. The only body that can authorize every change operation, but the slowest to notice a problem that doesn't have a constituent complaint attached to it yet.

institutions.name: Department of Public Works
knownBiases: Assumes existing infrastructure works until an outage proves otherwise.
Documents a dependency only after someone traces it, never before.
institutions.notes: Maintains utilities and shared infrastructure. Keeps the city running day to day; rarely gets credit until something stops working.

institutions.name: Building & Safety Division
knownBiases: Flags a violation the moment it's visible during a scheduled inspection, and can miss the same violation for years if it's hidden behind a passed one.
institutions.notes: Performs inspections and executes changes once authorized. Does not issue its own authorizations -- it acts on City Council's or Department of Public Works's, never its own.
